name: Mitsuki Yahiro
source:
He is the eldest son of the Mitsuki family, a prestigious family of Onmyoji (exorcists).
As an Onmyoji (exorcist), his abilities are rather mediocre; he's a complete failure.
Energetic and resilient, never giving up easily. Always on the move.
He always has a shikigami (spirit familiar) with him.

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060629221246fw_/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/akiiro_cyara.html#%E5%85%AB%E5%B0%8B]official website[/url]]
